The reviewer re-ran its own reproductions against f8591aba: all fixed, no regressions (probe sets 24/24 and 35/35).

Forward obligations recorded: SlateLink command replays still echo frozen receipts (disclosed in README item 11; C7 should route replay through a live re-read), the C2-backed reader must supply the governing head version for changed listings (C8), TRUNCATE/DROP sits outside trigger scope for the future erasure package, and the unknown-outcome lockout is per-process (shared store needed for multi-worker, C8/C9).
